source.value:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=-u+av+b,\,y=2u-5v+c
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 \\ 2 & -5\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$

decisions.question: e-9506

authoring.question: e-9506
authoring.value:
An affine transformation $\mathbf T:\mathbb R^2\rightarrow\mathbb R^2$ is a function of the form

$$
\mathbf x = A \mathbf u + \mathbf b,
$$

where $\mathbf x, \mathbf u,$ and $\mathbf b$ are column vectors in $\mathbb R^2,$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

First, notice that we can express the given transformation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

Separating the constants and expressing the linear part as a product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5u+v-6 \\ 2u+4v\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5u+v \\ 2u+4v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 \\ 2 & 4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c = 1+2+0 = 3.
$$
